motivation.revision_rule: No revision-v2 result may be inspected before this protocol and its derived job matrix pass validation.

lineage.legacy_results_role: Historical context only unless a variant is explicitly marked reusable below.

scientific_question: Does expert semantic grouping improve robustness to unseen semantic telemetry-family loss beyond an equal corruption budget, random non-semantic grouping, and ordinary training?

forward.artifact_role: Reuse the v1 frozen partitions and source-fitted imputer after hash verification.

reverse.partition_method: Use the deterministic feature-hash buckets from scripts/prepare_data.py: 60% train, 15% validation, 10% calibration, and 15% source test.
reverse.imputation: Fit a new median imputer on the reverse source-training partition only.
reverse.artifact_rule: Prepare and hash all reverse-direction artifacts before any reverse-direction training.

early_stopping_conditions: each of the four semantic singleton losses with source-training-median replacement
calibration_conditions: each of the four semantic singleton losses with source-training-median replacement
policy_selection_conditions: each of the four semantic singleton losses with source-training-median replacement
matched_development_schedule.calibration_method: Platt scaling on source-only model logits
matched_development_schedule.classification_threshold: Maximize attack-class F1 on the source policy partition pooled across the matched development conditions.
matched_development_schedule.reason: The submitted study used different validation, calibration, and policy schedules for the ordinary and augmented models. Revision v2 removes that comparison confound.

matched_complete_baseline.role: Ordinary-training baseline under the same source-only development schedule as every robust variant.

iid_matched_feature_dropout.training_corruption: For each masked copy, draw one budget uniformly from [32, 23, 12, 10], then mask that many unique predictors sampled without replacement.

random_partition_group_mask.training_corruption: Partition the 77 predictors into random disjoint groups of sizes 32, 23, 12, and 10; assign one random group to each masked copy.
random_partition_group_mask.partition_generation: numpy.random.default_rng(partition_seed).permutation over the feature order in config/experiment_metadata.json, sliced in group-size order [32, 23, 12, 10].
random_partition_group_mask.evaluation_losses: Always evaluate on the fixed expert semantic groups, not on the random training groups.
random_partition_group_mask.role: Tests whether semantics add value beyond block size and grouped corruption.

semantic_uniform_singleton.training_corruption: One seed-assigned expert semantic singleton mask per copied row.

semantic_exhaustive_singleton.training_corruption: Retain the complete row and create one source-median copy for each of the four expert semantic singleton losses.
semantic_exhaustive_singleton.role: Separates semantic coverage from the one-mask-per-row computational budget.

seen_pairwise_oracle_upper_bound.training_corruption: Retain the complete row and create one copy with a uniformly selected expert semantic pairwise loss.
seen_pairwise_oracle_upper_bound.role: Clearly labelled non-generalization upper bound; excluded from claims that pairwise loss is unseen.

evaluation.all_four_groups_excluded_reason: No predictive information remains when every predictor group is replaced.
evaluation.target_loading_rule: For each direction, load target features and labels only after every model, calibrator, classification threshold, and selective cutoff for that direction is frozen.
evaluation.primary_endpoint: Attack-class F1 averaged across the six semantic pairwise losses within each model seed, using source-training-median replacement.
key_secondary_endpoints: Area under the F1-versus-loss-severity curve across complete, singleton, pairwise, and triple loss

execution_stages.description: Verify v1 forward artifacts; train or restore all forward models; freeze every source-only calibrator and policy.
Evaluate all forward models on the forward source test and compute the source-only continuation gate.
After every forward source policy is frozen, evaluate all precommitted forward models on the sealed target; do not select or remove methods or conditions.
If the source-only continuation gate passes, prepare frozen reverse artifacts and execute all precommitted reverse models and evaluations.
execution_stages.target_labels_accessible: Only under the reverse-direction role defined in this protocol.

source_only_continuation_gate.comparison_condition: Forward source-test pairwise-average attack-class F1 with source-training-median replacement.
comparators: random_partition_group_mask averaged over the five partition seeds within each model seed
pass_requirements: The semantic-minus-comparator mean difference is positive for both comparators.
The two-sided 95% t confidence-interval lower bound across five model seeds is greater than zero for both comparisons.
At least four of five model seeds favor semantic_uniform_singleton for both comparisons.
Complete-telemetry F1 for semantic_uniform_singleton is no more than 0.005 below matched_complete_baseline.
source_only_continuation_gate.if_pass: Proceed to the reverse-direction stage and preserve a method-comparison framing.
source_only_continuation_gate.if_fail: Do not claim that semantic grouping is the causal advantage. Stop reverse-direction training unless separately frozen as a benchmark extension; reframe the paper as a controlled robustness benchmark and transfer-failure study.

statistical_analysis.unit_for_primary_inference: Model seed after averaging the six pairwise conditions; random-partition controls are first averaged over partition seeds within model seed.
statistical_analysis.small_sample_note: With five nonzero pairs, the smallest exact two-sided Wilcoxon p-value is 0.0625; effect sizes and confidence intervals remain primary.
statistical_analysis.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within each dataset, replacement mechanism, and predeclared comparison family.
statistical_analysis.random_partition_reporting: Report the full distribution across all five fixed random partitions; no partition may be removed.

prohibitions: Do not modify, delete, or retag release v1.0.0.
Do not overwrite any v1 model, policy, result, or completion marker.
Do not inspect revision-v2 target labels before all source-only policies for that direction are frozen.
Do not alter model seeds, random-partition seeds, group definitions, endpoints, continuation rules, or unfavorable conditions after training begins.
Do not merge exploratory pilot results into confirmatory summaries.
Do not edit the manuscript's results or conclusions until revision-v2 aggregate outputs are frozen and audited.
